# T-1: Lock metadata ownership

<!-- Auto-generated by `sdd-forge spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Verify and, if needed, constrain flow metadata writes so a command mutates only the selected current flow's authoritative flow.json, including after a worktree flow switches authority to the main repository.

## Acceptance Criteria
- A regression test creates or simulates at least two active flows and proves a current-flow metadata write does not change the other flow.json after the worktree authority switch.
- The selected spec id remains bound or is explicitly routed when a worktree flow uses a main-repository FlowManager after merge.
- If production code contains a cross-flow write path, the path is changed to use the selected current spec or bound flow manager.
- The implementation does not introduce a loop that writes metrics or step state to every active flow.

## Implementation Notes
Start with src/flow/registry.js, src/flow/lib/flow-context.js, src/lib/flow-manager.js, and src/lib/flow-store.js. The likely correction is binding the selected spec id when flow-context switches to a main-repository FlowManager after merge, or passing the selected spec id explicitly through post-hook metadata mutations.

## Test Strategy
Spec-local unit or integration test with temporary flow state files should assert the other flow.json content before and after the selected-flow write.
